spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Chapter on Adam

---

**¶1:**
Concerning the Most Ancient Church, the first spiritual state of humanity. When it was constituted inwardly, how was its spiritual character formed? How was its life generated? Was the manner in which spiritual life arose in that earliest church the same as the manner in which spiritual life is received among people today, or not? Does a distinction exist between how that primordial perception of good and truth came into being and how regeneration proceeds now?

---

**¶2:**
Observe that the Most Ancient Church was immense in spiritual capacity, and the fullness of its wisdom was vast. Its states of spiritual life were also abundant — it endured through many states while dwelling in the natural world. Nor was it alone in its greatness; all who were regenerated in that era likewise possessed abundant and enduring spiritual states. Yet those who are born into spiritual life today have been diminished in capacity; their states of interior life have grown fewer. Moreover, why has the manner of regeneration today — among those now born into the spirit — become altered compared with that of these first [GAP-1: …] from one state to another? Behold, the knowledges of spiritual truth and the fixed arrangements of celestial order continue in their positions. Why then have the fullness and enduring states of these later ones diminished, and why has the human being become lesser in spiritual stature, compared to those ancients who belong to the earliest spiritual generations?

---

**¶3:**
Those states increased, turned through their cycle, and diminished — because there are five degrees of governing dominion and ruling principles appointed within the ordering of spiritual knowledge and in the heavens above it. They bear designations by which they are known: the first is the complete state of celestial life; the second is the state of spiritual change; the third is the state of natural illumination; the fourth is the state of particular influx; the fifth is the state of momentary perception. These five degrees and these five interior dwelling-places exist within the spiritual order and the heavens. These dwelling-places possess five governing powers, and those powers are set as rulers over them. The ruler of the complete celestial state exists; the ruler of the state of spiritual change exists; the ruler of natural illumination exists; the ruler of particular influx exists; the ruler of momentary perception exists. Each in turn stands above its companion; and in turn the higher is made ruler over the lower beneath it.

---

**¶4:**
In this way, new states of understanding are generated, and new affections likewise. They come into being under these governing powers. And so these ruling principles have received dominion from the beginning of creation until the consummation of the age. In the beginning of the spiritual generations, the powers that governed the complete celestial states held sway. Therefore, because of this, the spiritual offspring brought forth in their generations and under their life: their states of interior life were found to be the greatest. They attained enduring spiritual life in the era of the Most Ancient Church, and in that of its successor perception — its son — and in that of all who came after them.

---

**¶5:**
After they ceased to reign — namely the governing principles that ruled the complete celestial states — the powers that govern the states of spiritual change themselves took dominion. As the states of spiritual change are lesser than the complete celestial states, so again [GAP-2: REVIEW — this diminishment] is also the case with the spiritual offspring who were brought forth under them. Their duration of spiritual life is less [GAP-3: REVIEW — than the duration of those brought forth] in the era of the powers that governed the complete celestial states.

---

**¶6:**
When the dominion of the powers governing the states of spiritual change was completed, the powers of natural illumination received authority after them. Therefore, as the states of natural illumination are lesser than the states of spiritual change, so also is this the case with the spiritual offspring brought forth under them. Their duration of interior life is less than the duration of those born under the powers that govern the states of spiritual change. Again, even so with the spiritual offspring brought forth under particular influx and under momentary perception — their channel of spiritual life is less than that of the states of spiritual change and the states of natural illumination.

---

**¶7:**
The duration of spiritual life among people has contracted to almost nothing. Their states of illumination have diminished. Their interior states have grown fewer — because the good and the wisdom that were present in the world during those first spiritual generations were more abundant than what remains today. Indeed, because of this they have diminished in their spiritual capacity. The duration of their interior life has become less for them.

---

**¶9:**
By what manner of spiritual generation was the entire race of derivative goods and truths brought forth from one understanding and one will — the Most Ancient Church in its intellectual and volitional aspects?

---

**¶10:**
For the character of those earliest spiritual generations is that they are richer in their wisdom and purer in spiritual capacity. Their interior states are more abundant. Thus again, their spiritual offspring — the goods and truths they produce — are far more numerous than the spiritual offspring of this present time. They dwelt a longer time [GAP-4: …] within the interior state of the will that bore them. Afterwards, they [GAP-5: …] a multitude from a single interior state. There are times when five distinct goods and truths were brought forth from a single state of love, and times when six were brought forth from [GAP-6: REVIEW — a] single state of love. Some were fewer than this; again, some greater. Indeed, because of this the spiritual offspring of the primordial will multiplied, and of all the derivative affections proceeding from it. The external mind was filled by reason of them alone.

---

**¶11:**
For those whom the spirit begets today, in these last generations, they stand diminished and impaired. Indeed, only one by one are they brought [GAP-7: REVIEW — forth] from a single interior state. Scarcely two, or fewer, or slightly more. They are even rendered lacking in spiritual beauty, being diminished in their capacity, and feeble in their powers of action.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: about Adam, the first man. When he was fashioned, how did they sculpt him? Or, how did they beget him? Rather, is his begetting like the begetting that is brought forth today, amongst humankind; or not? Does a distinction exist between his birth and the one that they bring forth today?

Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [generations, from] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?

They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.

So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.

After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!

When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their conduit is less than that of the months and the days.

The life span of the people has drawn in to nothing. Their days have diminished. Their years have become less; because the life and the ligh[t that] was in the world in these first generations was more than that of today. Indeed, because of this have they diminished in their stature. Their life span has become less for them.
By what sort of birth was the entire offspring of mankind made from one man and one woman, Adam and Eve?

For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. Thus, again, even their offspring is much more than the offspring of this tim[e]. They were spending a longer time [being fashioned] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [brought forth] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone.

For, they whom they beget today, in these last generations, they stand diminished and maimed. And, indeed, one by one do they bri[ng t]hem [forth] from a single womb. Hardly two, or [l]ess or more. They are even made ugly in their aspect, being diminished in their size, and feeble in their limbs.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates "these first [GAP-1] from one state to another," where "from one state to another" corresponds to "place to place" in the natural register; "generations" is the standard Kephalaia term for the earliest eras (used repeatedly in ¶4, ¶7, ¶10), and "from" bridges to "place to place."
The editor's "is" correctly supplies the copula needed for "this is also the case," matching the parallel construction in ¶6 ("this also is the case with the offspring").

fills.explanation: The editor's fill exactly mirrors the parallel construction in ¶6 ("Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months"), and the spiritual reading confirms this comparative structure about duration of spiritual life.

The spiritual reading describes dwelling within the interior state of the will while being constituted; "being fashioned" echoes ¶1's vocabulary of fashioning and sculpting, and naturally describes the formative activity during gestation in the womb.

The spiritual reading indicates producing a multitude from a single interior state; "brought forth" is the standard Kephalaia term for birth/production used throughout ¶10–11 ("five were brought forth," "six were brought forth"), and grammatically fits before "a number in a single womb."
The editor's "a" is confirmed by the exact parallel earlier in the same sentence ("five were brought forth from a single womb") and by the spiritual reading's "a single state of love."

The editor's "forth" completes "bring them forth," matching the consistent phraseology "brought forth from a single womb" used throughout the chapter, and confirmed by the spiritual reading's "brought forth from a single interior state."
